hero.title: Bring in records from other tools
hero.subtitle: AI summaries · test results · notes
hero.speech: Pasted material is sorted first, then saved only when you confirm.

promptCard.title: Ask another AI to summarize what it knows about you
promptCard.description: If you've talked about yourself with another AI, paste these questions there. Then copy its reply back here.
promptCard.copyHint: Copies the import questions to the clipboard.

pasteCard.title: Reply or test result
pasteCard.description: Paste an AI reply, a past personality test result or notes about yourself. PolaScope will sort the content and add tags.
pasteCard.sortHint: Sorts the pasted material before saving.

toast.promptPlaced: The questions were placed below. Long-press to copy them.
toast.saveFailed: Couldn't save it. The sorted result is still here; please try again.
toast.storagePending: Your text was saved, but the backup file didn't upload.

result.title: Imported record
result.degraded: Detailed sorting isn't available right now. Your content has been sorted using basic rules on this device. Try again later.
result.keepHint: Saves this imported result to your records.

saved.title: Saved
saved.body: Your summary and HustleK's answers can use these records.
saved.moreHint: Clears this import and starts another one.

markdownRetention.consent: The file is analyzed on this device. The titles and text of the notes you choose are kept as encrypted records. Each note's text is limited to 4,000 characters.
markdownRetention.review: The title and text of each chosen note, up to 4,000 characters per note, are added to your records.

pendingDevice.title: Notes left on this device
pendingDevice.body: Notes saved on this device before sign-in: {{count}}. Someone else may have written them. Import only if they are yours.
pendingDevice.accountUnavailable: We can't confirm this account's email right now, so import is paused.
pendingDevice.confirm: Import my notes into this account
pendingDevice.confirmHint: Saves the notes on this device to the account shown.
pendingDevice.deferHint: Keeps these notes on this device.
pendingDevice.error: Some notes couldn't be imported. The remaining notes are still on this device.

hub.hubTip: Only what you approve is kept.
hub.whereBody: Analyzed on this device. Only the results you choose on the review screen are kept, encrypted.
hub.connectorNote: The app doesn't read your location directly yet. Upload a location history file you exported, such as from Google Timeline.
hub.googleConnectorNote: Securely link your Google account in the browser. Read-only (view events).
hub.gErrNative: Connect on web for now. App (native) support comes later.
hub.consentFine: You consent to what's collected, where it's kept, for how long, and your right to delete. Comms/location import is locked for minors.
hub.errBody: Check that the exported format is right
hub.importFailed: Couldn't import that. Nothing was recorded. Try again.
hub.ledgerWarnBody: The import itself was saved, but the chosen transactions were not booked. Re-import the same file to book them.
hub.ledgerWarnPartBody: {failed} of the chosen transactions could not be booked; {inserted} were. Re-import the same file to book the missing ones; rows already booked are not booked again.
hub.historyFine: Delete removes the source this import created. A source it can't confirm this import created stays, and you're told why. People and ledger entries created from an import can be removed in the Relationships and Ledger screens. Comms/location import is server-locked for minor accounts.
hub.revokeNeedsSignIn: Sign in to withdraw - the server-side rows must be deleted together.

kakao.name: KakaoTalk
kakao.what: Only plan mention counts and relationship frequency. We don't store message text.

takeout.name: Google Timeline
takeout.what: Only place/dwell patterns. Exact coordinates aren't stored.

sms.name: SMS
sms.what: Only plan mention counts. We don't store message text.

live-location.name: Location history
live-location.what: Only place/dwell patterns. Exact coordinates aren't stored.

health.name: Health
health.what: Only totals (steps, etc). Detailed records aren't stored.

email.name: Email
email.what: Only plan/schedule signals, not the full body.

notion.name: Notion · Obsidian
notion.what: Brings your notes in as records.

google.name: Google Calendar
google.what: Brings only upcoming event titles + times. No body/attendees.

google-tasks.name: Google Tasks
google-tasks.what: Brings your to-do titles in as records.

hub.ledgerSkippedNote: {skipped} transactions were already booked and were not booked again.
